Payment form requests full card number + CVV + expiry directly on web form. This violates PCI DSS standards - legitimate processors use tokenized fields and never ask for CVV storage. The direct collection of sensitive payment data combined with security badges that may be fake suggests potential phishing/scam pattern. Red flag: legitimate SaaS platforms use third-party payment processors (Stripe, Square) that handle card data securely, not direct form submission.

This does NOT meet HIGH trust threshold required for SSN + banking information submission.
